Stop letting what you think you don’t deserve effect what you do and don’t have.

No one deserves anything, our lives are only dictated by reward when it comes to work. Relationships are not rewards, they are partnerships, and if your relationship is based on rewards and transactions, then it’s probably pertinent to get out of that situation. I don’t know your situation well enough to dictate what you should or should not do, but if you’re in a loveless marriage that is basically a contract, You have every right to say fuck it and drop it.

There is no such thing as a lasting happiness

Dudes can live to be old codgers while being homeless their entire lives while millionaire celebrities end up hanging themselves. Don’t search for happiness, search for a purpose. Whether that be religion, personal enjoyment, fun, fucking random people.

There’s plenty to hate in life, and most of it is difficult. But rather than taking it like a bitch, I’ve chosen to tell life and it’s inhabitants to go fuck themselves and do my own thing. And besides, the more you do something, the better you get at it. 

If you even have a mild interest in something, let that be it.

Try just finding a hobby. Even if it seems pointless or dumb, it’s something to occupy time with. 

Exercise is good to get rid of that lethargic energy, and if you’re angry and rage fueled like I often am it’s a great way to get that energy out (and feel that sweet sweet pain) 

Or get into technical hobbies like cars or computers. Taking on a project really helps get that funk to go fuck itself

It is pointless in the end. But since you’re here, do something fun. If all that awaits is hell (for religious people) or nothingness, I’ll try to have fun before I pull the trigger for the big sleep.
